name: save_learner_state
description: Persist a learner's progress, profile, or sight record to the Alice message store. Use this when a learner reaches a milestone, shares profile information, or completes a sight. The data is written to the daemon inbox and archived for retrieval.

learner_id.description: Unique learner identifier (e.g. username, email hash, or self-chosen handle). Alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, dots — max 64 chars.

data.description: The state payload to persist. Flexible schema — include whatever is meaningful for the state_type. For progress: current_level, completed_levels[]. For profile: name, goal, background. For sight: sight_number, sight_title, completed_at.
